title: Preaching of the Word
definition: Preaching of the Word is the public proclamation and explanation of Scripture for the glory of God and the building up of His people.
summary: Preaching of the Word is the public proclamation and explanation of Scripture with authority, clarity, and Gospel aim.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is proclaimed as Lord, Savior, and fulfillment of Scripture through faithful preaching.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine centers on heralding God's Word to God's people and to the lost. Preaching is not a motivational talk with verses attached; it is Scripture opened, Christ proclaimed, sin exposed, grace announced, and obedience urged. It carries an authoritative burden because God addresses His people through His Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because the Church lives by every word from God, not by trends or human cleverness. Faithful preaching guards doctrine, awakens conscience, comforts the afflicted, and points hearers to Christ. When preaching is weakened, the Church becomes vulnerable to drift.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive preaching with humility, examination, and prayerful response. Pray for preachers to handle Scripture faithfully and courageously. Measure preaching by biblical truth and Christ-centered clarity, not merely style or entertainment.
